suspected_cause.description: The team's current best explanation of what is causing the incident

severity.description: Incident severity level, such as SEV1 or SEV2

incident_commander.description: The person running the incident response

mitigation_status.description: What is being done to fix the incident, or whether it is resolved

customer_impact.description: What customers are experiencing right now

affected_region.description: A cloud region that is currently affected, such as us-east-1

affected_service.description: A service that is currently affected, such as checkout
